summary: Implementation plan for RazorTune, a native Kotlin/Compose Material 3 YouTube Music client powered by innertubex v0.11.7 and AndroidX Media3 MediaSessionService. Covers confirmed Phase 1 UX choices (Dynamic Material You dark theme, Songs-default search with filter chips, expandable Now Playing sheet from Mini-Player, and signed-out Playlists prompt), visual design system, architecture diagram, and stream resolution pipeline.
